capabilities.description: Ingest and normalize the uploaded BOQ (Excel) and contract (PDF) as the authoritative source of record; extract BOQ items, clauses, rates, and quantities; store with provenance and versioning.

Generate and submit interim payment certificates (progress claims) against BOQ items, applying retention (Clause 14.3: 5% per claim, 50% released at Taking-Over and 50% at DNP end) and performance security (Clause 4.2: 10% of Accepted Contract Amount).
Track time for completion (Clause 8.2: 730 days from Commencement Date), compute delay damages at 0.1% of Accepted Contract Amount per day, cap at 10% (Clause 8.7), and provide alerts and reporting.
Manage quality assurance and inspection & test plan (ITP) records: create, assign, track, and close ITP inspections, link to BOQ items and progress claims, and maintain auditable evidence.
Maintain a controlled document register for all project documents (contract, BOQ, drawings, ITPs, claims), with version control, approval status, and search.
Orchestrate the progress claim lifecycle: submission, review, approval, rejection, with role-based access and audit trail; enforce contractual rules.
Automatically check each claim and document against contract clauses (retention, performance security, delay damages cap) and flag non-compliance.
Provide dashboards and reports on claim status, delay damages exposure, QA/ITP completion, and document register health.
